currentCoordinate.coordSource: OpenStreetMap way 819618193 – Losby Gods; Kartverket Losbyveien 270; Lørenskog municipality; Losby Gods historical and visitor pages
currentCoordinate.coordNote: The named present-day manor and hotel polygon is retained as a semantic area anchor for Losby Gods as an institution and estate environment. It is not represented as the exact original manor wing, sawmill site or full forest-property geometry.

legacyCoordinate.reasonReplaced: The 2026-07-26 production moved the nearby uncontracted eastern point approximately 61.2 metres west to the deterministic centroid of the named Losby Gods building geometry.

previousProductionCoordinate.reasonRetained: The source geometry, centroid and address controls remain correct. This pass changes locatorType from historic_site to institutional_area so the OSM-based verified geometry conforms to Coordinate Source Contract v1.

identity.resolvedIdentity: The named historic manor and present-day hotel complex at Losbyveien 270, used as the physical anchor for the broader Losby estate, forestry, sawmill, worker, hunting and recreation landscape.
identity.identityProblem: The named OSM polygon includes the older manor component and modern hotel additions. It can anchor the coherent Losby institution, but must not be treated as exact geometry for the mid-nineteenth-century manor or the historic forest property.
identity.splitReason: The manor, hotel, park and immediate estate core form one coherent named institution. Sawmills, smallholdings and the wider forest estate remain historical context rather than competing canonical coordinates.

requiredEvidence: municipal and operator history for manor and estate
explicit distinction between old manor and modern hotel additions
explicit rejection of Losbyveien 1 as physical address

evidence.finding: Way 819618193 is named Losby Gods, tagged building=hotel and tourism=hotel and has national building reference 12444672. Its deterministic polygon centroid is 59.88680008666081, 10.983017201931101.
evidence.reason: Provides reproducible named geometry for the applied institutional area anchor.

evidence.finding: Kartverket returns one exact Losbyveien 270 object with municipality 3222, farm/use number 91/16, address code 6150 and representation point 59.88686319648732, 10.983615156991803, approximately 34.1 metres from the centroid.
evidence.reason: Confirms the physical and postal identity of the named complex.

evidence.finding: The municipality documents the oldest hotel section as a mid-nineteenth-century hunting lodge and places it within a broader history of sixteenth-century sawmills, forestry, smallholdings, workers and estate ownership.
evidence.reason: Defines the broader historical identity that the present-day named complex physically anchors.

evidence.finding: The operator documents forestry and sawmill history, smallholders and servants, Christiania owners, hunting and hospitality, modernization and the 1997–1999 restoration and hotel expansion.
evidence.reason: Links the current institution to the historic estate economy without reducing the place to hotel use.

evidence.finding: The operator describes the modern complex as built in connection with the more than 160-year-old main building and restored and expanded in 1997–1999.
evidence.reason: Confirms that the OSM way is a composite present-day complex rather than pure nineteenth-century geometry.

evidence.finding: Losby Gods publishes Losbyveien 270, 1475 Finstadjordet as its current address.
evidence.reason: Cross-checks the Kartverket address object and current institutional identity.

evidence.finding: The hotel publishes GPS point 59.888312527778, 10.981993666667 and advises drivers to enter Losbyveien 1 before following Losbyveien to the end. The GPS point is approximately 177.6 metres from the applied centroid.
evidence.reason: Access evidence only; it is not the canonical building-complex coordinate.

evidence.finding: Kartverket places Losbyveien 1 approximately 3.7 kilometres from the applied centroid.
evidence.reason: Rejected as canonical because it is only a routing hint.

evidence.finding: Nominatim resolves way 819618193 as Losby Gods, type hotel, with representative point 59.8868735, 10.9839841 and complete polygon geometry.
evidence.reason: Named-object cross-check; canonical uses the deterministic raw-geometry centroid.

evidence.finding: The former coordinate 59.88685, 10.98411 lies approximately 61.2 metres east of the retained centroid and lacked a source contract.

notes: The 61.2-metre move occurred in the 2026-07-26 production and is preserved.
This pass changes locatorType from historic_site to institutional_area because OSM supplies the physical polygon while municipal and operator sources define the broader historical estate identity.
Losbyveien 270 is the physical address; Losbyveien 1 remains a routing hint approximately 3.7 kilometres away.
